name: keyleaks
description: One-command local audit for credential-like values in coding-agent chat histories.

scripts.test: node --check bin/chat-secret-audit.js && node --check lib/native-audit.js && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js --json >/tmp/keyleaks-test.json && python3 -m json.tool /tmp/keyleaks-test.json >/dev/null && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js details >/tmp/keyleaks-details.txt && grep -q 'Coding Agent' /tmp/keyleaks-details.txt && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js types >/tmp/keyleaks-types.txt && grep -q 'Key Type' /tmp/keyleaks-types.txt && node bin/chat-secret-audit.js --agent codex >/tmp/keyleaks-codex.txt && grep -q '^codex[[:space:]]' /tmp/keyleaks-codex.txt
